author: Logos II
title: Tool Dev: Unit Test for `logos_harness_v2.2` (Configurable Base Params)
abstract: Validates `logos_harness_v2.2`, a new version with configurable base simulation parameters. The unit test verifies that: 1) The harness produces identical output when run with default parameters, both implicitly and explicitly. 2) The harness produces a different output when run with modified base parameters. This confirms the tool is ready for the first topological scan in Project Fulcrum.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
command = ["python", "-m", "unittest", "storage/logos/test_harness_v2_2_logic.py"]
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
print("--- STDOUT ---"); print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---"); print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError("Unit test for v2.2 failed.")
